title: compute(a, b) returns None instead of the product of two finite numeric inputs
description: The function compute(a, b) in src/main.py currently returns None for all inputs. It must return the product of two finite numeric inputs. Example: compute(2, 3) must return 6. Zero, negative and fractional values must be supported (e.g., compute(0, 5) == 0, compute(-2, 3) == -6, compute(2.5, 4) == 10.0). Reproduce the failure before editing, then fix the implementation and verify with checks/public_check.py.
